final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats), s2 AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(pid) AS n FROM s1 GROUP BY bats), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s2) SELECT s2.bats, s2.n, CAST(s2.n AS REAL) / s3.total FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.total IS NOT NULL
